# Documentation

Generated from `rune reference --json` of rune 0.1.17, so these pages describe what the binary does.

- [Commands](commands.html): Every command and flag the binary accepts.
- [Configuration](configuration.html): Every setting with its type, default and variable, and every limit.
- [Providers](providers.html): How to connect each provider preset.
- [Key bindings](keys.html): Every action and the keys it has by default.
- [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.html): What `rune doctor` checks and how to fix each problem.
- [Benchmarks](benchmarks.html): Published benchmark results.

<!-- https://rune.heyaadi.com/docs/commands.html -->

# Commands

Generated from the command table the parser reads, so every entry here is a command the binary accepts.

## Global flags

Accepted anywhere on the command line.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--model <id>` | Override the model for this process. |
| `--provider <name>` | Override the provider for this process. Run `rune connect` to list them. |
| `--effort <level>` | Override the reasoning effort: auto, none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max. |
| `--fast` | Request fast mode where the provider supports it. |
| `--no-fast` | Disable fast mode for this process. |
| `--permission-mode <mode>` | Override the permission mode: ask, auto, full-access. |
| `--limit <name=value>` | Override one limit. Repeatable. Use off to disable a limit. |
| `--add-dir <path>` | Add a workspace directory for this process. Repeatable. |
| `--no-additional-dirs` | Ignore saved additional directories for this process. |
| `--offline` | Refuse provider requests except to a model server on this machine, disable web tools, skip remote MCP checks and restrict sandboxed shell networking. Local MCP and unsandboxed commands can still use the network. |
| `--allow-unsandboxed` | Run commands where the host has no sandbox backend. Without this, such a host refuses them. Also RUNE_ALLOW_UNSANDBOXED=1. |
| `--network` | Let sandboxed shell commands use the network. --offline still wins. |
| `--json` | Emit machine-readable output where supported. |
| `--accessible` | Use append-only labelled session output and line input for screen readers. |
| `--ascii` | Use ASCII terminal decorations, preserving message text. |
| `--theme <name>` | Override the theme for this process. |
| `--provider-order <a,b>` | Prefer these upstream providers in order. |
| `--provider-strict` | Restrict requests to the listed providers. |
| `--trace <dir>` | Write each provider request and response, redacted, to this directory. |
| `-h, --help` | Print help. |
| `-v, --version` | Print the version. |

## Run

### `rune resume [last|id]`

Resume a saved session, defaulting to the latest in this workspace

### `rune ask [flags] <prompt>`

Run one bounded turn without an interactive session

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object instead of Markdown. |
| `--jsonl` | Stream bounded JSONL events (takes precedence over --json); the records are listed in the README under Headless runs. |
| `--no-save` | Do not create a session. |
| `--checkpoints` | Snapshot the workspace before and after the turn so it can be restored with rune session restore. |
| `--image <path>` | Attach a PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP file. Repeatable; 8 MiB total, at most 16 images. |
| `--max-steps <n>` | Stop after this many model steps; the last one answers without tools. 0 means no limit. |
| `--timeout <seconds>` | Stop the run after this many seconds and report what it did. |
| `--max-cost <usd>` | Stop the run once its estimated cost reaches this many dollars. |
| `--goal <objective>` | Work toward this objective; it is added to the instructions. |
| `--judge` | With --goal, check the result against the objective before finishing. |
| `--context-report` | Add a context object to the JSON result: the last request's estimated tokens by part. |

```text
Exit status:
  0    the model finished (stop_reason end_turn)
  1    the run failed: provider_error, refused, content_filter, stalled, or an error before the first request
  3    a limit ended the run and its output is usable: max_model_turns, max_output_tokens, time_limit, spend_limit, objective_token_budget
  130  interrupted by SIGINT
  143  stopped by SIGTERM or SIGHUP
```

### `rune acp [--log-file <path>]`

Serve the Agent Client Protocol over standard input and output

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--log-file <path>` | Write diagnostics to this file. |

### `rune review [context]`

Review the pending changes in the workspace

- `pr`: Same as `rune review`; reviews pending workspace changes with optional context.
- `issue`: Same as `rune review`; reviews pending workspace changes with optional context.

### `rune bench <tasks-dir> [--only <ids>] [--trials <n>] [--split <name>] [--jobs <n>] [--logs <dir>] [--json]`

Measure the configured model and harness on coding tasks

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--only <ids>` | Run only these comma-separated task identifiers. |
| `--trials <n>` | Run each task this many times, 1 to 20. |
| `--split <name>` | Run only tasks of this split: dev, heldout or all. |
| `--jobs <n>` | Run this many tasks at once, 1 to 16. |
| `--logs <dir>` | Keep each run's stderr and JSON report in this directory. |
| `--json` | Print one JSON object with every run and the summary. |

### `rune connect [<name>] [--json]`

Connect a model provider, choosing from a list

- `login`: Same as `rune connect`; connects a provider, choosing from a list when no name is given.
- `setup`: Same as `rune connect`; connects a provider, choosing from a list when no name is given.
- `provider`: Same as `rune connect`; connects a provider, choosing from a list when no name is given.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Emit JSON. |

## Sessions and local records

### `rune sessions [--all] [--search <text>] [--limit <n>] [--cursor <c>] | rune sessions prune --older-than <days> [--keep <n>] [--dry-run] [--json]`

List sessions

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--all` | Include sessions from every workspace. |
| `--older-than <days>` | With prune: remove sessions last updated more than this many days ago. |
| `--keep <n>` | With prune: never remove the n most recently updated sessions. |
| `--dry-run` | With prune: list what would be removed and remove nothing. |
| `--search <text>` | Match a case-insensitive literal fragment in titles or user messages. |
| `--limit <n>` | Page size, 1 to 100. |
| `--cursor <c>` | Continue from a previous page. |
| `--json` | Emit JSON. |

### `rune session <last|id> [--search <text> | --record <id|all>] [--json] | rune session --id <id> [--search <text> | --record <id|all>] [--json] | rune session export <last|id> | rune session export --id <id> | rune session fork <last|id> --at <seq> [--json] | rune session fork --id <id> --at <seq> [--json] | rune session migrate <id> | rune session recover <id> | rune session restore <last|id> --turn <n> [--dry-run] [--force] [--json]`

Inspect, search, export, fork, migrate, or recover one session

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--id <id>` | Inspect, search, export, or fork this exact session identifier, taking precedence over a positional selector. |
| `--at <seq>` | Fork through this inclusive saved event sequence. All tool calls must have results. |
| `--search <text>` | Search saved message, tool, and summary records, including compacted context, by a case-insensitive literal fragment. Return original records and sequence positions. |
| `--allow-large` | Permit migrating an oversized session. |
| `--turn <n>` | Restore the workspace to its state before this turn. |
| `--dry-run` | List the files a restore would change and change nothing. |
| `--force` | Restore even when files changed outside the session since its last checkpoint. |
| `--record <id\|all>` | Retrieve exact original messages archived by manual compaction. IDs are stable within the session; all lists every archived record. |
| `--json` | Emit JSON. Export always emits ordered JSONL event records. |

### `rune tree [last|id] [--json] | rune tree --id <id> [--json]`

Show the branch structure of a session

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--id <id>` | Show the tree of this exact session identifier, taking precedence over a positional selector. |
| `--json` | Emit JSON. |

### `rune usage [--period <24h|7d|30d>] [--json] | rune usage export [--period <24h|7d|30d>]`

Report or export token usage recorded on this machine

- `cost`: Same as `rune usage`; reports token usage recorded on this machine.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--period <span>` | One of 24h, 7d, or 30d. Export defaults to all retained records. |
| `--json` | Emit JSON. Export always emits ordered JSONL usage records. |

## Account and configuration

### `rune auth [status|logout] [--json]`

Show or manage stored credentials

- `logout`: Same as `rune auth`; without an action, shows connection status. Use `rune auth logout` to remove the stored credential.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Emit JSON. |

### `rune capabilities [--require-images] [--require-tool-streaming] [--json]`

Check provider capabilities and context provenance before a turn

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--require-images` | Require image content support in the dialect. |
| `--require-tool-streaming` | Require incremental tool argument streaming. |
| `--json` | Emit JSON. |

### `rune models [--refresh] [--explain [<model>]] [--json]`

List the models of the connected provider

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--refresh` | Download the published model catalog now. |
| `--explain` | Show how requests to this model are shaped, and why. |
| `--json` | Emit JSON. |

### `rune mcp list | check [server] | login <server> | logout <server> | import claude-desktop <file>`

Manage MCP servers: mcp list, mcp check, mcp login, mcp logout, mcp import

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Emit JSON diagnostics without secrets. Import always emits full configuration JSON; save it as `.mcp.json` at the workspace root. |

### `rune permissions [--explain <target> | --simulate <file>] [--json]`

Show the permission mode and rules

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--explain <target>` | Explain one tool:target action, such as shell:pwd. JSON includes the outcome, deciding rule and layer. |
| `--simulate <file>` | Dry-run a JSON array of {tool, target} calls in order, without execution or approval writes. |
| `--json` | Emit JSON. |

### `rune sandbox [explain] [--external-access] [--json] [-- <command>]`

Explain command policy: sandbox [explain] [-- <command>]

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--external-access` | Preview an explicit external-access grant to the shell context. |
| `--json` | Emit JSON. |

### `rune projects [status|approve|reject|reset]`

Inspect or change workspace trust

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Emit JSON. |
| `--yes` | Approve project hooks and rules without asking. |

### `rune config [--explain] [--json] | rune config get <key> [--json] | rune config set <key> <value> | rune config unset <key> | rune config path [--json] | rune config edit`

Show, read or change the configuration and where each value came from

- `settings`: Same as `rune config`; shows resolved configuration and value sources.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--explain` | Show the source layer of every key. |
| `--json` | Emit JSON. |

### `rune keys [--json]`

List the key actions, their keys, and the file that rebinds them

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Emit JSON. |

### `rune limits [--json]`

List every limit with its effective value and source

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Emit JSON. |

### `rune workspace <list|add <path>|remove <path>|clear>`

Manage additional workspace directories

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Emit JSON. |

### `rune prompt [--show | --tools]`

Show the assembled system prompt

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--show` | Print the assembled prompt. |
| `--tools` | Print each advertised tool schema as one JSON line. |

## Diagnostics and maintenance

### `rune status [--json]`

Show the resolved configuration and runtime state

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Emit JSON. |

### `rune doctor [--provider <name>] [--json]`

Check the local setup, or one provider with a short round trip

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--provider <name>` | Send one short tool round trip to this provider and report what works. |
| `--json` | Emit JSON. |

### `rune upgrade [--check] [--json] | rune upgrade --from <path> --checksum <hex> [--target <path>] [--json]`

Replace the installed binary with a verified artifact

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--check` | Report whether a newer release exists and change nothing. |
| `--from <path>` | Artifact to install. |
| `--checksum <hex>` | Published checksum of that artifact. |
| `--target <path>` | Binary to replace. Defaults to the running one. |
| `--json` | Emit JSON. |

### `rune uninstall [--target <path>] [--keep-state] [--yes] [--json]`

Remove the installed binary and, on request, local state

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--target <path>` | Binary to remove. Defaults to the running one. |
| `--keep-state` | Leave the state directory in place. |
| `--yes` | Confirm removal of the state directory. |
| `--json` | Emit JSON. |

### `rune completion <bash|zsh|fish|powershell>`

Generate shell completion from the command table

### `rune reference [--json] [--write <path>]`

Print the generated command reference

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print every command, setting, limit, key, preset and doctor check as JSON. |
| `--write <path>` | Write the reference to a file. |

### `rune help [command]`

Print help

- `-h`: Same as `rune help`.
- `--help`: Same as `rune help`.

### `rune version`

Print the version

- `-v`: Same as `rune version`.
- `--version`: Same as `rune version`.

# Configuration

Settings are read from the user configuration file, the project's file, the environment and the command line. `rune config --explain` shows the value in force and where it came from, and `rune config set <key> <value>` writes one.

## Settings

| Setting | Type | Default | Variable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `provider` | string | unconfigured | `RUNE_PROVIDER` | Provider requests are sent to; set with rune connect. |
| `model` | string, in the models table under the provider's name | none | `RUNE_MODEL` | Model used for the active provider. |
| `context_window` | number, in the models table entry of the model | 128000 | `RUNE_CONTEXT_WINDOW` | Input tokens the selected model accepts. |
| `base_url` | string | default | `RUNE_BASE_URL` | Endpoint for the active provider. |
| `api_key_env` | string | default | `RUNE_API_KEY_ENV` | Environment variable that holds the credential. |
| `permission_mode` | one of ask, auto, full_access | auto | `RUNE_PERMISSION_MODE` | How tool calls are approved: ask, auto or full_access. |
| `anonymous` | boolean | false | none | Connect to a loopback endpoint without a credential. |
| `offline` | boolean | false | `RUNE_OFFLINE` | Refuse provider requests and keep tools off the network. |
| `effort` | one of auto, none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max | auto | `RUNE_EFFORT` | Reasoning effort requested from the model. |
| `temperature` | number | model default | `RUNE_TEMPERATURE` | Sampling temperature, 0 to 2, for models that accept one. |
| `fast_mode` | boolean | false | `RUNE_FAST_MODE` | Request fast mode where the provider offers it. |
| `theme` | string | auto | `RUNE_THEME` | Terminal theme name, or a light or dark pin. |
| `color` | one of auto, truecolor, 256, 16, none | auto | none | Color depth: auto, truecolor, 256, 16 or none. |
| `motion` | one of full, reduced | full | none | Spinner motion: full, or reduced for a static glyph. |
| `reasoning` | one of collapsed, tail, full | collapsed | none | How reasoning is shown: collapsed to one line, tail with its newest line, or full. |
| `hyperlinks` | one of auto, on, off | auto | none | Link file targets in tool rows: auto, on or off. |
| `notify` | one of auto, bell, off | auto | none | Notify when a turn ends or input is needed while the terminal is unfocused: auto, bell or off. |
| `terminal_title` | boolean | true | none | Show the session and whether it is idle, working or waiting in the window title. |
| `statusline` | list of strings | model,mode,unsandboxed,context,queued,effort,net,branch,mcp,cost,tasks,workspace,session | none | Status row fields to show, highest priority first. |
| `ascii` | boolean | false | `RUNE_ASCII` | Draw terminal decorations with ASCII only. |
| `web_tools` | boolean | false | `RUNE_WEB_TOOLS` | Let the web fetch and search tools reach the network. |
| `edit_tool` | one of auto, replace, patch | auto | `RUNE_EDIT_TOOL` | File-edit tool offered to the model: auto, replace or patch. |
| `mcp_tools` | one of auto, eager, deferred | auto | none | How MCP tools are offered: auto, eager or deferred. |
| `shell_network` | boolean | false | none | Let sandboxed shell commands use the network. |
| `allow_unsandboxed` | boolean | true | `RUNE_ALLOW_UNSANDBOXED` | Run commands unsandboxed when no sandbox works on this machine. |
| `sandbox_cache_roots` | list of strings | default | none | Directories commands may write besides the workspace. |
| `post_tool_hook` | table | disabled | none | Command that observes each completed tool result. |
| `pre_tool_hook` | table | disabled | none | Command that may veto a tool call before it runs. |
| `hooks` | list of tables | none | none | Programs run at points of a session. |
| `mcp_servers` | table of tables, one per server | none | none | MCP servers connected in every workspace. |
| `vision_model` | string | unavailable | none | Model that describes images on the active provider. |
| `review_model` | string | default | `RUNE_REVIEW_MODEL` | Model that reviews tool calls in auto permission mode. |
| `compaction_model` | string | default | `RUNE_COMPACTION_MODEL` | Model that summarizes a conversation too large for its own. |
| `auto_upgrade` | one of notify, off, install | notify | `RUNE_AUTO_UPGRADE` | Check for a newer release automatically. |
| `collapse_tool_calls` | boolean | true | none | Collapse groups of tool calls in the transcript. |
| `banner` | boolean | true | none | Open a session with the version line and a tip. |
| `ambiguous_width` | number | 1 | none | Columns an East Asian ambiguous character takes, 1 or 2. |
| `session_titles` | boolean | true | none | Name sessions from their first prompt. |
| `checkpoints` | boolean | true | none | Snapshot the workspace at each turn so command changes can be undone. |
| `cache_warming` | boolean | false | none | Keep the prompt cache warm while a session is idle. |
| `context` | boolean | true | none | Load project instructions and workspace context. |
| `additional_directories` | list of strings | none | none | Workspace roots besides the current directory. |
| `provider_order` | list of strings | none | `RUNE_PROVIDER_ORDER` | Upstream providers to prefer, in order. |
| `provider_strict` | boolean | false | `RUNE_PROVIDER_STRICT` | Send requests only to the listed upstream providers. |
| `shell_env` | list of strings | none | `RUNE_SHELL_ENV` | Extra environment variables passed to shell commands. |

## Limits

Every limit takes a count, or `off` to remove it. A hard ceiling still applies to a limit set to `off`.

| Limit | Default | Unit | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `max_agent_steps` | 0 | items | 0 to 10000 | Maximum model tool-loop steps per turn; zero means unlimited. |
| `max_consecutive_tool_failures` | 3 | items | 1 to 10000 | Consecutive identical tool failures allowed before refusing the next duplicate. |
| `verification_reminders` | 1 | items | 0 to 8 | Times a turn that changed files without a check afterwards is asked to verify. |
| `session_spend_cents` | off | cents | 1 to unbounded | Estimated spend at which an interactive session stops sending requests. |
| `max_tool_result_bytes` | 32768 | bytes | 0 to unbounded | Bytes retained from one tool result before spilling. |
| `max_turn_result_bytes` | 8388608 | bytes | 0 to unbounded | Tool-result bytes one turn retains across its steps. |
| `skill_catalog_bytes` | 32768 | bytes | 0 to unbounded | Combined size of the skill catalog placed in the prompt. |
| `skill_description_bytes` | 256 | bytes | 0 to unbounded | Size of one skill description in the catalog. |
| `skill_file_bytes` | 1048576 | bytes | 0 to unbounded | Largest skill file that may be loaded. |
| `mcp_description_bytes` | 1024 | bytes | 0 to unbounded | Size of one MCP tool description. |
| `mcp_search_result_bytes` | 1048576 | bytes | 0 to unbounded | Bytes of one MCP server's tool listing read at connection. |
| `mcp_server_instructions_bytes` | 2048 | bytes | 0 to unbounded | Instructions accepted from one MCP server. |
| `mcp_selected_schema_bytes` | 65536 | bytes | 0 to unbounded | Schema size for one explicitly selected MCP tool. |
| `project_instruction_file_bytes` | 65536 | bytes | 0 to unbounded | Size of one project instruction file. |
| `project_instructions_total_bytes` | 131072 | bytes | 0 to unbounded | Combined size of all applicable project instructions. |
| `repository_map_bytes` | 4096 | bytes | 0 to unbounded | Rendered Rust repository symbol map bytes; zero disables it. |
| `image_adapter_output_bytes` | 20480 | bytes | 0 to unbounded | Text produced by an image analysis adapter. |
| `command_output_bytes` | 32768 | bytes | 0 to unbounded | Bytes retained from one command's output. |
| `read_file_lines` | 2000 | items | 0 to unbounded | Lines returned by one file read. |
| `read_file_line_bytes` | 2000 | bytes | 0 to unbounded | Bytes per line before truncation in a file read. |
| `list_entries` | 1000 | items | 0 to unbounded | Entries returned by one listing or glob. |
| `parallel_tool_calls` | 8 | items | 1 to 64 | Tool calls executed concurrently within one step. |
| `subagent_children` | 256 | items | 0 to 4096 | Subagent children one parent session may register. |
| `provider_head_timeout_ms` | 120000 | ms | 1000 to 3600000 | Time to wait for a model response head. |
| `provider_request_timeout_ms` | 600000 | ms | 1000 to 7200000 | Total time allowed for one model request attempt. |
| `provider_max_attempts` | 10 | items | 1 to 20 | Provider attempts before the turn fails. |
| `acp_permission_timeout_ms` | 120000 | ms | 0 to unbounded | Time allowed for a client to answer an ACP permission request. |
| `mcp_operation_timeout_ms` | 60000 | ms | 0 to unbounded | Time allowed for one MCP operation. |
| `mcp_startup_timeout_ms` | 30000 | ms | 0 to unbounded | Time allowed for an MCP server to start and be discovered. |
| `mcp_restart_limit` | 1 | items | 0 to 10 | Automatic restarts permitted for a local MCP server. |
| `review_context_bytes` | 8192 | bytes | 0 to unbounded | Current-turn tool output shown to the safety reviewer. |
| `review_holds_per_turn` | 64 | items | 0 to unbounded | Safety review holds permitted in one turn. |
| `review_timeout_ms` | 30000 | ms | 0 to unbounded | Time allowed for one safety review request. |
| `compaction_trigger_percent` | 80 | percent | 10 to 99 | Compaction trigger as a percentage of usable input. |
| `context_cap_tokens` | 256000 | items | 0 to 100000000 | Largest context window used for the compaction ceiling, in tokens. Zero turns the cap off. |
| `compaction_keep_tokens` | 20000 | items | 0 to 1000000 | Newest conversation kept verbatim by compaction, in estimated tokens. |
| `web_fetch_redirects` | 5 | items | 0 to 20 | Redirects followed by one web fetch. |
| `web_fetch_bytes` | 1048576 | bytes | 0 to unbounded | Bytes returned by one web fetch. |
| `web_fetch_timeout_ms` | 30000 | ms | 0 to unbounded | Time allowed for one web fetch. |
| `web_search_results` | 10 | items | 0 to unbounded | Sources returned by one web search. |
| `vision_batch_images` | 8 | items | 1 to 16 | Images analysed in one vision request. |
| `additional_directories` | 16 | items | 0 to 64 | Additional workspace roots permitted. |
| `prompt_history_bytes` | 1048576 | bytes | 0 to unbounded | Prompt history size before compaction. |
| `steering_queue_depth` | 64 | items | 0 to unbounded | Messages accepted into a steering queue for one turn. |

<!-- https://rune.heyaadi.com/docs/providers.html -->

# Providers

Each preset names an endpoint and the variable its key is read from. `rune connect <name>` connects one; `rune connect` alone chooses from a list. The configuration shown is the smallest file that selects the preset.

## anthropic

Anthropic Messages API. Dialect: `anthropic`. Direct from the model vendor; API key.

```text
rune connect anthropic
```

- Endpoint: `https://api.anthropic.com`.
- Key variable: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.

```text
provider = "anthropic"

[models]
anthropic = "<model id>"
```

## openai

OpenAI Responses API. Dialect: `chat_completions`. Direct from the model vendor; API key.

```text
rune connect openai
```

- Endpoint: `https://api.openai.com/v1`.
- Key variable: `OPENAI_API_KEY`.

```text
provider = "openai"

[models]
openai = "<model id>"
```

## gemini

Google Gemini Generate Content API. Dialect: `gemini`. Direct from the model vendor; API key.

```text
rune connect gemini
```

- Endpoint: `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta`.
- Key variable: `GEMINI_API_KEY`.

```text
provider = "gemini"

[models]
gemini = "<model id>"
```

## deepseek

DeepSeek API, OpenAI-compatible. Dialect: `chat_completions`. Direct from the model vendor; API key.

```text
rune connect deepseek
```

- Endpoint: `https://api.deepseek.com`.
- Key variable: `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`.

```text
provider = "deepseek"

[models]
deepseek = "<model id>"
```

## zai

Z.ai GLM models, OpenAI-compatible. Dialect: `chat_completions`. Direct from the model vendor; API key.

```text
rune connect zai
```

- Endpoint: `https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4`.
- Key variable: `ZAI_API_KEY`.

```text
provider = "zai"

[models]
zai = "<model id>"
```

## moonshot

Moonshot Kimi models, OpenAI-compatible. Dialect: `chat_completions`. Direct from the model vendor; API key.

```text
rune connect moonshot
```

- Endpoint: `https://api.moonshot.ai/v1`.
- Key variable: `MOONSHOT_API_KEY`.

```text
provider = "moonshot"

[models]
moonshot = "<model id>"
```

## minimax

MiniMax models, OpenAI-compatible. Dialect: `chat_completions`. Direct from the model vendor; API key.

```text
rune connect minimax
```

- Endpoint: `https://api.minimax.io/v1`.
- Key variable: `MINIMAX_API_KEY`.

```text
provider = "minimax"

[models]
minimax = "<model id>"
```

## chat_completions

Any OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint. Dialect: `chat_completions`. Any compatible endpoint; API key.

```text
rune connect chat_completions
```

- Endpoint: none built in; set `base_url`.
- Key variable: `OPENAI_API_KEY`.

```text
provider = "chat_completions"
base_url = "<endpoint>"

[models]
chat_completions = "<model id>"
```

## ollama

Local Ollama models, native discovery and Chat Completions requests. Dialect: `chat_completions`. Local servers; no credential (loopback only).

```text
rune connect ollama
```

- Endpoint: `http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1`.
- No key: the server is reached on this machine only.

```text
provider = "ollama"
anonymous = true

[models]
ollama = "<model id>"
```

# Key bindings

The keys each action has when the key file does not name it. `rune keys` lists the bindings in force.

| Action | Where | Keys | Does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `submit` | editor | `enter` | send the draft |
| `newline` | editor | `shift+enter`, `ctrl+j`, `alt+enter` | insert a newline |
| `complete` | editor | `tab` | complete a command, value or path |
| `queue` | turn | `tab` | queue the draft for after this turn |
| `pull_queued` | turn | `alt+up` | edit the newest queued message |
| `interrupt` | turn | `esc` | stop the running turn; with text, press twice |
| `clear` | editor | `esc` | clear the draft; up brings it back; twice when empty rewinds |
| `history_search` | editor | `ctrl+r` | search earlier prompts |
| `transcript` | editor | `ctrl+o` | open the transcript, or expand the paste at the caret |
| `external_editor` | editor | `ctrl+g` | edit the draft in VISUAL, EDITOR, or vi |
| `mode_cycle` | editor | `shift+tab` | cycle ask, auto and plan |
| `paste_image` | editor | `ctrl+v`, `alt+v` | attach the image on the clipboard |
| `help` | editor | `?` | show every key, on an empty draft |
| `toggle_plan` | editor | `ctrl+t` | show or hide the plan above the prompt |
| `word_left` | editor | `alt+b`, `ctrl+b`, `alt+left` | move one word left |
| `word_right` | editor | `alt+f`, `ctrl+f`, `alt+right` | move one word right |
| `kill_word_back` | editor | `ctrl+w`, `alt+backspace` | cut the word before the caret |
| `kill_word_forward` | editor | `alt+d` | cut the word after the caret |
| `kill_to_line_end` | editor | `ctrl+k` | cut to the end of the line |
| `kill_to_line_start` | editor | `ctrl+u` | cut to the start of the line |
| `yank` | editor | `ctrl+y` | insert the last cut text |
| `yank_pop` | editor | `alt+y` | cycle earlier cuts after a yank |
| `undo` | editor | `ctrl+_`, `ctrl+7` | undo a draft edit |
| `redo` | editor | `alt+r` | redo a draft edit |
| `line_start` | editor | `home`, `ctrl+a` | start of the line; again for the draft |
| `line_end` | editor | `end`, `ctrl+e` | end of the line; again for the draft |
| `viewer_close` | viewer | `q`, `esc`, `ctrl+o`, `ctrl+d` | close the transcript |
| `approve_once` | approval | `y` | run the action once |
| `approve_session` | approval | `a` | allow the action for this session |
| `approve_always` | approval | `p` | always allow the action in this project |
| `deny` | approval | `n`, `esc` | deny the action |
| `deny_with_message` | approval | `tab` | deny and tell the model what to do instead |
| `viewer_search` | viewer | `/` | search the transcript |
| `viewer_next` | viewer | `n` | go to the next match |
| `viewer_previous` | viewer | `shift+n` | go to the previous match |
| `viewer_expand` | viewer | `e` | expand or collapse the selected entry |
| `viewer_expand_all` | viewer | `shift+e` | expand every entry, or collapse them all |
| `viewer_pager` | viewer | `v` | open the whole transcript in a pager |

<!-- https://rune.heyaadi.com/docs/troubleshooting.html -->

# Troubleshooting

`rune doctor` runs these checks in this order and prints `ok`, `warning`, `problem` or `skipped` for each, with a fix for anything wrong.

| Check | Looks at | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| version | the running binary | nothing to fix |
| workspace | the directory rune runs in | run rune from a directory |
| state root | where sessions and settings are kept | make the directory writable |
| legacy state | an older state layout | move what you need into the state root |
| update | whether a newer release exists | run rune upgrade |
| clock | the system clock against the network | correct the system clock |
| terminal | colours, keys and clipboard of this terminal | use a terminal with the missing feature |
| configuration | every configuration layer | fix or remove the named key |
| provider | the endpoint, the key and the model | run rune connect |
| limits | limits changed from their defaults | run rune limits to see each source |
| reviewer | the model auto mode reviews actions with | set review_model to a served model |
| sandbox | what can restrict commands on this host | install the named sandbox helper |
| network | whether commands may use the network | set shell_network or use /network |
| git | git, which undo of command changes needs | install git |
| checkpoints | the checkpoint store for this workspace | run rune sessions prune |
| mcp | every enabled MCP server | fix the server or run rune mcp login |
| shell | the shell commands run through | set SHELL |
| disk | free space where sessions are kept | free space |
| proxy | proxy variables in the environment | unset a proxy that is wrong |
| certificates | the certificate roots requests trust | set SSL_CERT_FILE |
